description: This Java class implements a WebSocket service for the Thingsboard platform, managing WebSocket sessions, handling various telemetry and attribute subscription commands, and integrating with security and data services.

classes.name: DefaultWebSocketService
classes.description: Main service class managing WebSocket sessions, handling commands, subscriptions, and communication with clients.

classes.name: WsCmdHandler
classes.description: Generic handler class for WebSocket commands, parameterized by command type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up executors and command handlers.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down executors on service destruction.

methods.name: handleSessionEvent
methods.description: Handles WebSocket session lifecycle events (established, error, closed).

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Processes incoming command messages from WebSocket clients.

methods.name: sendUpdate
methods.description: Sends updates to clients, either by session ID and command ID or via CmdUpdate.

methods.name: cleanupIfStale
methods.description: Cleans up sessions that are no longer active.

methods.name: processSessionClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a session is closed.

methods.name: processSubscription
methods.description: Validates and registers a new subscription, enforcing limits.

methods.name: handleWsAttributesSubscriptionByKeys
methods.description: Handles attribute subscription with specific keys.

methods.name: registerNewSessionSubId
methods.description: Registers a new subscription ID for a session.

methods.name: handleWsTimeSeriesSubscriptionByKeys
methods.description: Handles time series subscription with specific keys.

methods.name: getTsSubscription
methods.description: Creates a time series subscription object.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCallback
methods.description: Creates callback for time series data fetch.

methods.name: validateCmd
methods.description: Validates command ID and optional custom validation.

methods.name: sendUpdate
methods.description: Overloaded methods to send updates to clients.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends ping messages to all sessions periodically.

methods.name: mergeAllAttributesFutures
methods.description: Merges multiple attribute fetch futures into one.

methods.name: getAttributesFetchCallback
methods.description: Creates callback for attribute fetch validation.
